k3p_control_parity.global_rng_limit: Unseeded process-global RNG blobs differ between separately launched processes. Actual models, Adam histories, required arrays and all bound named streams match exactly; runtime audits record zero unintended stream deviations. Whole checkpoint equality is not claimed.

limits: Five preregistered diagnostics; no seed robustness or ordinary qualification.
Released cloud is a separate prior/host cohort and has zero MoG smoke/reference credit.
Paired noisy output law has zero independent reference credit; primary clean/live remains required.
Runtime and hardware match; optimizer-phase and evaluation times are scoped, not contention-independent performance.

preregistration.release_host_limit: The explicit named z4 MLP/Fourier2/N(0,1) cloud host implements the released public recipe and distributions, not the original sequential-global-RNG toy100 launch. The adapted MoG arm changes host, initialization distribution, z_dim and batch size intentionally.

prior.exception_reason: Faithful v0.7.0 GAN v3 public ParticlePrior law; sigma_rel and standardize are inert on its particle branch. Separate diagnostic, no MoG qualification.

recommendation: Conclude the five registered diagnostics and retain the failed evidence. No arm is eligible for ordinary qualification, robustness continuation or public-default promotion. Do not expand this matrix from these results.
